title: kate-ui: clamp a span window to the buffer
summary: span_line_window returns the half-open line range a viewport can show. A zero row count is empty. The end stops at the line count. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The helper has no GPUI type. Linux CI runs the test. It does not paint the spans.

definitions.definition:
#[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
pub(crate) fn span_line_window(first_line: u32, row_count: u32, line_count: u32) -> std::ops::Range<u32>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: The start is first_line clamped to the line count. The end is the start plus row_count, clamped to the line count. A row count of 0 returns an empty range at that start. A line count of 0 returns 0..0. The function has cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)). Leave session.rs unchanged. regression_tests.name: layout::tests::span_line_window_clamps_to_the_buffer
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because span_line_window does not exist. first 10, rows 2, and 100 lines return 10..12. first 98, rows 10, and 100 lines return 98..100. A row count of 0 returns an empty range. A line count of 0 returns 0..0.
